The '''Corellian slavers''' were a group of [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] who operated on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|It's just the tip of the asteroid. There is something big going on here.|[[Bandor Mokk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtB" />}}
The Corellian slavers started their operation by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. They were particularly active all over the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] and their [[Corellian Slaver Bunker|base]] was located just northwest of the city. They captured random people on Corellia and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] them in their bunker. [[Faye Patrick]] was one of the criminals who captured the future slaves.<ref name="SWG:TtB" /> Dozens and dozens of persons were captured by the slavers,<ref name="SWG:IE" /> including [[Kyran Silene]],<ref name="SWG:TtB" /> [[Noro Bok]] and [[Akkus Meik]],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> [[Anyza Ekull]],<ref name="SWG:S">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Slavemaster" on Corellia</ref> [[Gordo Zek]], [[Zorgom Z'all|Zorgom]], [[Norith Z'all|Norith]] and [[Neeka Z'all]],<ref name="SWG:FC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Forgotten Child" on Corellia</ref> [[Bannoc G'noc]] and [[Narlissa]],<ref name="SWG:LL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Love Lost" on Corellia</ref> [[Vermon Skeetz]], [[Dulor Norr]] and [[Akers Radch]].<ref name="SWG:PR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Petty Resolve|Corellia}}</ref> The slavers were responsible for a 500% increase in the number of missing persons on Corellia in one month. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] therefore went to investigate the case.<ref name="web">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66901&resource=features|text=Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of slaves that included Anyza Ekull,<ref name="SWG:S" /> Zorgom and Norith Z'all,<ref name="SWG:FC" /> Bannoc G'noc,<ref name="SWG:LL" /> and Vermon Skeetz,<ref name="SWG:PR" /> and led by Kyran Silene managed to escape the slaver bunker.<ref name="SWG:IE" /> They did not reach Tyrena and were forced to establish a camp in the wilderness.<ref name="SWG:TtB" />

In the meantime, Kyran Silene's wife, [[Madison Silene]], recruited a spacer to investigate the disappearance of her husband. After killing Faye Patrick, the spacer managed to find the camp and the escaped slaves.<ref name="SWG:TtB" /> The spacer agreed to help the former slaves and moved to the Corellian Slaver Bunker. The spacer fought several guards but successfully infiltrated the bunker. With the help of several slaves, the spacer managed to access the depth of the bunker,<ref name="SWG:IE" /> and even killed the slavemaster.<ref name="SWG:S" /> The spacer finally sliced the bunker's main computer. Using the bunker's own communications array, the spacer broadcasted the slavers' records on the CorSec emergency request channels.<ref name="SWG:IE" /> Dozens of CorSec agents quickly moved to the slaver bunker and freed all the slaves.<ref name="SWG:HbtKS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Head back to Kyran Silene|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian slavers appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Corellian slavers were added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
